name: if(C >= SlotStart, if(C < SlotEnd, Q / Slots, 0), 0) [ratio]

sources.text: Decode reserves contiguous equally sized MLA slots. Each request group merges FP32 score maxima, denominators and latent weighted sums. Each rank scans its reserved slots, masks unused entries and appends the current latent and rotary key only if it owns the slot. The weighted-value multiply rounds unnormalized weights to BF16.
